# PCM fixtures

Two short lossless files for the engine's and the player's tests, made by
`make.py` in this folder (`python make.py`, with FFmpeg on `PATH`): 8,193
stereo frames each (an odd length, so the last block is short), of integer sawtooth ramps at half scale, the right channel a third of a
period ahead. No tags, no cover.

| File | Rate | Bits |
|---|---|---|
| `ramp-44100-16bit.flac` | 44.1 kHz | 16 |
| `ramp-48000-24bit.flac` | 48 kHz | 24 |
